trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours. There is no extra task, no online mode and no DLC tied to it: finish everything else and this one follows on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, all in one playthrough.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically.
Play a single playthrough with cheats off: cheats disable trophies and saving.
Track the set here: the checklist shows your progress toward all 54.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first story beat and cannot be replayed, so it lands in your list as soon as you finish it. Just play the introduction through: there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss before it.

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.
Story trophies cannot be replayed, so keep a save at the start of each chapter.
Leave cheats off: they disable trophies and saving on this save.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 closes once its last mission is done. The chapter trophies are automatic: finish the story beats in order and each one pops at the chapter's end. The first meditation spot sits in Chapter 1, so start the meditation set early (see Positive Mental Attitude).

steps.text: Finish every mission in Chapter 1.
Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before the chapter ends; it may not come back.
Keep a separate save at the start and end of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Nothing here needs a special setup: play the missions in order and it arrives on its own. The name is printed on PlayStation with asterisks, exactly as shown.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Chapter 2.
Play the missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
Keep a save at the chapter's start in case you want to revisit it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 ends with this trophy. By now the map is open and the side systems (activities, collectibles, the stranger strands) are available, so this is a good moment to start the long counts — stunts, WAiNK spots and the shooting range — while you push the story on.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Chapter 3.
Start the long counts now: stunts, WAiNK spots and the shooting range.
Keep a save at the chapter's start.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's trophy pops at the chapter's end. The story is nearing its finale, so before the last missions, finish the character-locked side strands: some are Lucia-only and some are Jason-only, and a few carry an hourglass and expire.

steps.text: Finish every mission in Chapter 4.
Before the finale, finish Lucia-only and Jason-only strands; hourglass quests expire.
Keep a save at the chapter's start.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission's gold trophy. It pops when the last story mission ends, and it is the only gold trophy tied to the story. Finish the character-locked strands first: once the finale is done, some of them cannot be started.

steps.text: Finish the final story mission.
Clear Lucia-only and Jason-only side strands before the finale.
Keep a save before the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission early in the game. It pops when the mission ends, with no extra condition. Play it when the story offers it; like every story mission it cannot be replayed, so the trophy is tied to that one run through it.

steps.text: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
No preparation is needed before the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission. Finish it and the trophy pops. Heists in this game are story beats rather than free-roam robberies, so there is no way to repeat this one outside the story.

steps.text: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
Stock up on armour and ammo before the heist starts.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops. It is one of the named story missions whose trophy is hidden until earned, so it will not show in your list before you play it.

steps.text: Play the story mission Child's Play to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
Hidden until earned, so it will not appear in your list beforehand.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops. The mission's name gives little away, which is the point: the trophy is hidden until earned, and the guide keeps its details out of the spoiler-safe view.

steps.text: Play the story mission Headliners to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
Hidden until earned.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport. Finish it and the trophy pops. The airport also matters for a second trophy: the unscheduled departure (Catch Me If You Can) is a different moment at the same place, so do not confuse the two.

steps.text: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
The airport departure trophy is a separate moment; see Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops. It sits close to the finale, so treat it as a checkpoint: finish the expiring side strands before you push past it.

steps.text: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to its end.
It unlocks automatically on finishing the mission.
Clear expiring side strands before the late story missions.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the gold worth the most. The in-game 100% checklist opens after the story, under Progress and Stats. PowerPyx notes it is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly. Work through the checklist line by line; the game counts it, so the tracker here mirrors it.

steps.text: Finish the story, then open the 100% checklist under Progress and Stats.
Work the checklist line by line; most side quests are not required.
Collectibles count only partly toward 100%, so do not chase every set for this.
Leave this for the cleanup stage, after the story and the long counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 stunts count, and there are 397 in the game, so you can skip the ones you hate. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them freely. The 100% checklist wants 300, so doing 250 for this trophy leaves 50 more for the road.

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts: jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps.
There are 397 stunts in total, so skip the hard ones.
Mix types freely; the game counts every kind toward the same total.
100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each. You do not need to win or finish anything — just start each kind once. The nine are the game's side activities: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK photo spots. Tick them off as you meet them; the counter here tracks which you have tried.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once.
You only need to start each one, not win or finish it.
The nine cover racing, fishing, the range, drones, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and WAiNK.
Do it early: every activity is available once its spot opens on the map.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge is a short timed shooting trial at a range, and gold needs a clean run with few misses. Use a steady weapon, take the close targets first, and replay any challenge until gold lands — the range lets you retry as often as you like.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Each challenge is a short timed trial; replay it until gold lands.
Take close targets first and keep misses low; gold needs a clean run.
Ranges let you retry freely, so there is no penalty for a bad run.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race; winning once per location is enough, and you can retry a race you lose. Learn the course on a slow first lap, then push for the win on the next.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
One win per location is enough; losing a race costs nothing.
Learn the course on a slow lap, then race for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each distinct race only counts once, so you need 20 separate events rather than the same one 20 times. Spread them across the map: street races, off-road and water races all feed the same total.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; each distinct race counts once.
Any race type counts: street, off-road and water.
Spread them across the map instead of repeating one event.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival you meet at the water; the challenge is a head-to-head catch, and you win by landing the better fish. Bring decent tackle and fish the deeper spots — and do it when the challenge is offered, since it is tied to meeting Cal.

steps.text: Find Cal at the fishing spots and take his challenge.
Win the head-to-head by landing the better catch.
Fish the deeper spots with decent tackle for the bigger fish.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts, and finishing a single game — not a high score — is enough. Walk into an arcade, pick the cabinet you like, and play it to its end.

steps.text: Play any arcade cabinet to the end of one game.
Finishing one game is enough; no high score is needed.
Arcades are marked on the map once you have been near one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so it must be played as Lucia, and its missions carry on through the story. Finish the strand to its last mission and the trophy pops. Do it before the finale: character-locked strands cannot be started after it.

steps.text: Play Andy's strand as Lucia to its final mission.
Finish the last mission for Andy.
Do it before the finale; Lucia-only strands close after it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand through to its last mission and finish it. The strand is one of the five side-character finals, and each one is a small arc of its own rather than a single job.

steps.text: Play Kenton's strand to its final mission.
Finish the last mission for Kenton.
Side-character finals are arcs; follow the strand from its first job.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission and finish it. The five side-character finals each close a small arc; this one is Billy's.

steps.text: Play Billy's strand to its final mission.
Finish the last mission for Billy.
Follow the strand from its first job; the arc builds across several missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. There are 14 strands in the game, and only some count, so you have room to pick the ones you like. PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which strands qualify, so finish more than 8 to be safe and do them after the story if you prefer — they stay available.

steps.text: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.
There are 14 strands; only some count, so finish more than 8 to be safe.
Stranger strands stay available after the story.
Check which strands count before you stop at 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it. Like the other side-character finals, it is an arc that builds across several jobs.

steps.text: Play Randy's strand to its final mission.
Finish the last mission for Randy.
Follow the strand from its first job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so it must be played as Jason. Follow it to its last mission and finish it before the finale, since Jason-only strands close after it.

steps.text: Play Tyrone's strand as Jason to its final mission.
Finish the last mission for Tyrone.
Do it before the finale; Jason-only strands close after it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. This is the one trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: the first meditation spot can only be used early, in Chapter 1, so start the set as soon as you can and do not leave the first spot for later. The spots are quiet places across Leonida; the game marks each one once you meditate there.

steps.text: Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before the chapter ends; it may not come back.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.
The game marks each spot once you meditate there, so the set is easy to track.
This is the only trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a hunting contact; the animal is a specific one-off quarry, not a random spawn. Take the hunt when Bret offers it, track the animal, and take the shot cleanly — it is a single opportunity, so do not spook it.

steps.text: Take Bret's hunt when he offers it.
Track the unique animal and take a clean shot; it is a single opportunity.
Do not spook the animal: a failed approach may end the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and each set needs its own cards, so you are hunting three full sets rather than any three cards. Pick the sets whose cards cluster near each other and finish them one at a time.

steps.text: Complete 3 full collectible card sets out of 18.
Each set needs its own cards; three loose cards do not count.
Pick sets whose cards cluster together and finish one set at a time.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK phone app tags landmarks, curiosities and sculptures: open it at a spot and snap the tag. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count toward the same 100, so tag whatever you pass — the set builds itself as you explore.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app at a spot and tag it.
Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count toward the 100.
Tag spots as you explore; the set builds itself across the map.
Check the app's list to see which kinds of spots you still need.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, so you need most of them but not all. Pick the groups that suit how you play — driving, shooting, flying — and finish 50 across them. The challenge list shows your progress per group.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Challenges sit in 8 groups of 10; pick the groups that suit you.
The challenge list shows progress per group, so chase the nearest ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape. Get the heat to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map make it far easier than a shootout.

steps.text: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat clears.
Use a fast car and a quiet corner rather than fighting it out.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of the usual: keep the wanted level alive through all three robberies. Hit three shops in a row quickly, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop before the third till is empty.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner.
Keep the wanted level alive through all three robberies.
Hit the shops quickly and keep moving; do not let the heat drop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every distinct vehicle you drive counts once, so the set grows as you try new rides: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all feed it. Grab a new vehicle whenever you see one you have not driven, and the 100 arrives on its own.

steps.text: Drive 100 distinct vehicles; each one counts once.
Cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all feed the same total.
Take a new ride whenever you see one you have not driven.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time, so the window is short: pick a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger it, and drop five before it ends. Food, drinks or a shower at home buff your focus beforehand, and Adrenaline stretches the window.

steps.text: Find a cluster of enemies, then trigger Combat Focus.
Drop 5 enemies before the focus window ends.
Buff focus first with food, drinks or a shower, and bring Adrenaline.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. This is not the story mission at the airport — it is a separate free-roam moment: get to a runway or a plane and leave the airport in a way no timetable planned. It is hidden until earned, so the exact trigger is easy to miss.

steps.text: Go to VCIA airport in free roam, away from the story mission.
Leave the airport by an unscheduled route: a runway or a plane.
Hidden until earned; it is a separate moment from VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, and the trophy is hidden until earned, so the exact trigger is not spelled out. Get into a Rhino tank and use it, or take one down: either way the tanks are the point, and the military areas are where you will find them.

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank in a military area.
Use the tank, or take one down — the tanks are the point.
Hidden until earned; the description gives the hint, not the method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a one-shot stealth job: once you are spotted, the attempt is blown, so plan it. Go in quiet, take the goods without tripping the alarm, and leave before anyone raises it. It is the stealth trophy the guides single out as a single attempt.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet.
Take the goods without tripping the alarm or being seen.
Leave before anyone raises the alarm; being spotted blows the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a heist of its own: get in, crack the vault, and get out with the heat on you. Do them one at a time and escape cleanly each time — the count only rises on a clean getaway.

steps.text: Rob a bank vault and escape cleanly; the count rises on a getaway.
Repeat for 5 vaults, one at a time.
Plan the escape before you crack the vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes; stop one, crack it, take the cash and get away before the response arrives. It is a single clean getaway, so plan the escape route before you hit the truck.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it.
Crack it, take the cash, and escape before the response arrives.
Plan the escape route before you hit the truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The state is the whole map: Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the small towns. Visit each named area once and the counter rises; the map shades in as you go, so the gaps show where you still need to go.

steps.text: Visit each of the 52 named areas of Leonida once.
The map shades in as you go; the gaps show where to head next.
Cover Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the small towns.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around the map; hit one operation per gang and the set is done. Mark the gangs off as you go so you do not repeat one and miss another.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Each gang runs its own operations; hit a different gang each time.
Mark the gangs off as you go so none is missed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned down the exact spot or trigger yet. PowerPyx lists this as one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions are still unknown. Treat it as a moment to try on Ocean Beach rather than a checked step.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: try a cocktail spot with a view on Ocean Beach; the exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no guide has pinned down which showroom or what counts as the classic exit. PowerPyx lists this as one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions are still unknown.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: try smashing out of a vehicle showroom; the exact showroom and exit are not yet pinned down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description points to a bowling moment — the follow-through — at a specific alley. Play a frame there and finish the follow-through; it is hidden until earned, so the alley itself is the clue.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a frame and complete the follow-through.
Hidden until earned; the alley is the clue.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description hints at a partnership moment with mass appeal, but no guide has pinned down what it asks for. This is the sixth unconfirmed trophy in this guide: the condition is not yet known, so do not chase a specific method until one is confirmed.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: the condition is not yet known; wait for a confirmed method before chasing it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. The game logs decisions across the story and the side content, and the counter climbs as you make them. There is no single big choice: it is the accumulation of many small ones, so just keep playing and deciding.

steps.text: Make choices across the story and side content; PSN tracks a count to 500.
The count climbs on many small decisions, not one big choice.
Keep playing and deciding; the total builds across a playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description hints that the second try is the charm, but no guide has pinned down what must fail once and succeed the second time. PowerPyx lists this as one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions are still unknown.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: the trigger is not yet pinned down; it hints at succeeding on a second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description reads like a reaction to something strange, but no guide has pinned down what event it asks for. PowerPyx lists this as one of the five hidden trophies whose conditions are still unknown — likely a rare world event, but that is a guess, not a checked fact.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: the event is not yet pinned down; it reads like a rare world moment.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, but the precise method — where, with what, and what counts — is still being confirmed. KeenGamer notes the method is still being confirmed, so treat any specific recipe as unproven.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: the precise method is still being confirmed; do not trust a specific recipe yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts wash them into clean cash, and the counter tracks the total laundered. Keep feeding bills through your contacts as you earn them and the quarter-million arrives.

steps.text: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts; the counter tracks the total.
Keep feeding bills through as you earn them until $250,000 is washed.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, cars — and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough. Buy what you need as you go and the hundred thousand arrives without a grind.

steps.text: Spend across any shops: clothes, weapons, food, cars.
The total accumulates across the whole playthrough.
Buy what you need as you go; the total arrives without a grind.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are buyable properties around Leonida; each one costs money and gives you storage. Buy them as you can afford them, and the eighth purchase pops the trophy.

steps.text: Buy garage properties around Leonida; there are 8 in total.
Each garage costs money and gives you storage.
Buy them as you can afford them; the eighth pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive anyway and the ten arrives quickly.

steps.text: Find vehicles around Leonida and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register each vehicle; any vehicle counts.
Register the ones you drive anyway; ten arrives quickly.
